findings.title: Container runs a shell with nothing to do
findings.cause: container toolbox exits with code 0 as soon as it starts: it sets no command, and image busybox's default command is a shell, and a shell with no terminal and no input has nothing to do, so it exits at once and the kubelet restarts it; Deployment toolbox has 0 of 1 replicas ready

evidence.what: container toolbox exited with code 0 (Completed), restarted 6 times
container toolbox's image, command and args

findings.fix: Give the container the command it is meant to run; to keep a debugging container alive, run sleep infinity (or set stdin: true and tty: true), and use kubectl debug or kubectl run -it for an interactive shell.
